entries.zh: 拈签；抽签定夺（两人之间以小签枝拈签）
entries.en: to draw lots with little sticks (between two parties)

entries.zh: 拔去；拔除（将所栽之物连根拔掉）
entries.en: to pull out; to uproot (what has been planted)
to pull out and drag away
to pull and drag it by force; to press/compel
entries.notes: 音栏末段 apususale 无法辨识，释义以汉字「可迫」与西语栏 tirar y arrastrarlo 为据。

entries.en: to hurl the lance; to throw a dart

entries.zh: 牵绝：拉线弹线（绷紧线绳弹断以画直线）；拉断
entries.en: to pull the cord taut and snap it to mark a straight line (chalk-line); to pull until it breaks
entries.notes: 西语栏首词残缺，据 hacer la raya 推为匠人拉线弹线之事。

entries.en: to pull (someone) by the hair of the head
entries.notes: 字头汉字存疑（揖/楫）且西语栏涂改，据 el cabello 与「头毛」定释义。

entries.en: to draw lots; to divine by drawing tallies
entries.notes: 西语栏 tirar el Mandarino a caballo / a coton 与「抽籤」难合，疑串行，释义从汉字与音栏。

entries.zh: 〔存疑〕西语栏作「拔除根须」，与汉字「钱耳仔」不合
entries.en: to pull up roots (Spanish column); Chinese column incongruent
entries.notes: 两栏语义矛盾且首音节 T99 污损难辨，疑串行，无法定夺。

entries.zh: 抽签占卜（在神像前抽签）
entries.en: to cast lots before the idol (divination)
to drag in; to pull (someone) along through the street
entries.notes: 西语 sopa 疑为 soga（绳索）之误读；汉字「入」疑为「人」。

entries.en: defective entry; 'to pull and make compass strokes(?)' — doubtful
entries.notes: 西语栏残缺且缩写不辨，音栏 sy 字上有墨污一团，汉字「銫」义不明。

entries.zh: 红签；封书信用的红纸签条
entries.en: red paper slip used to seal letters
to shiver, to tremble (with cold or fear)
entries.notes: 汉字「趟」与 tiritar（发抖）义不合，疑串行或字误，释义从西语栏。

entries.zh: 寒极发抖（承上条 tiritar 的连读小字例语）
entries.en: [they] shiver with intense cold (run-on example phrase)
entries.notes: 小字与上行连读、otrio 段不辨，释义为推断。

entries.en: one suffering internal injury or consumption (an invalid)
entries.notes: 西语头词 Tiffico 不辨，疑为 tísico（痨病者）之误读；释义从汉字「内伤人」。

entries.zh: 〔存疑〕西语栏作「药铺的字号/招牌」，与汉字「招身」难合
entries.notes: titulo de botica 与汉字「招身」不合，疑串行，无法定夺。

entries.en: a hoe; to dig up / grub out with it
entries.notes: 西语头词 Fixeras 不辨，音栏 ca chun 与「锄」对音未明，据「锄」与 arrancar con ella 定释义。
西语头词 Fixeras 与本条不合（疑为上条串行），据汉字「刀」与音栏所记西语 cuchillo 定释义。
